description: This file defines extension methods for grain objects in the Orleans framework, providing utilities for obtaining grain references, IDs, and primary keys in various formats.

classes.name: GrainExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for Orleans grains, including reference conversion, ID retrieval, and primary key extraction.

methods.name: AsReference
methods.description: Returns a GrainReference for the given grain, handling nulls and different grain object types.

methods.name: AsReference<TGrainInterface>
methods.description: Returns a strongly typed grain reference implementing the specified interface.

methods.name: Cast<TGrainInterface>
methods.description: Casts the grain to a specified interface type, returning a strongly typed reference.

methods.name: AsReference
methods.description: Returns a grain reference cast to a specified interface type.

methods.name: GetGrainId
methods.description: Retrieves the GrainId associated with the grain object.

methods.name: GetWrongGrainTypeErrorMessage
methods.description: Generates an error message for unsupported grain types.

methods.name: IsPrimaryKeyBasedOnLong
methods.description: Checks if the grain's primary key is based on a long integer.

methods.name: GetPrimaryKeyLong
methods.description: Retrieves the primary key as a long, with optional extended key info.

methods.name: GetPrimaryKey
methods.description: Retrieves the primary key as a Guid, with optional extended key info.

methods.name: GetPrimaryKeyString
methods.description: Retrieves the primary key as a string.

methods.name: ThrowGrainNull
methods.description: Throws an ArgumentNullException indicating the grain argument is null.
